meta_title: P J E Delaney | Emergency Plumber Oldham

hero_eyebrow: Local Plumber — Fast, Reliable, Fair Prices
hero_subhead: Burst pipe, leaking radiator or broken boiler? We're here fast, any time. Same-day fixes for most jobs.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to new installations, we handle all aspects of domestic and commercial plumbing.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast, 24/7. We carry common parts on the van to get you back on track the same day.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Keep your heating running safely and efficiently. Annual servicing, repairs, and emergency callouts to prevent winter breakdowns.

services.title: Radiator Installation & Repair
services.desc: Cold spots? We replace and install radiators across your home, balance systems, and fix leaks before they cause damage.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Tap repairs, pipework installation, and full bathroom or kitchen refits. We leave sites clean and tidy.

services.title: Drain Unblocking & Clearance
services.desc: Slow drains and blockages cleared quickly using professional equipment. We identify the root cause and prevent future problems.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: New boiler and system installations designed for your home's needs. We advise on efficiency, grants, and long-term savings.

about_pullquote: I started this business to do honest work at fair prices, without the hidden charges.
about_para_1: P J E Delaney has been serving Oldham and the surrounding area for over 18 years. What began as a single tradesman has grown into a trusted name for emergency repairs and installations, built on straightforward pricing and real customer care. Every job, from a burst pipe at 2am to a full heating system overhaul, gets the same attention to detail.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we turn up when we say we will, fix the problem properly, and charge fair prices. We don't upsell, we don't use jargon, and we're never off the clock when you need us. That reliability has made us one of Oldham's most recommended plumbers.
reviews_heading: What Oldham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe in the middle of the night. Called P J E Delaney and someone picked up straight away. He was here within 45 minutes, fixed it properly, and didn't charge the earth. Couldn't fault him. Will definitely use again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: New boiler installation from start to finish. Peter explained everything clearly, wasn't pushy, and the work was done neatly. Heating bill has come down noticeably and the system is so quiet. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Karen H.

reviews.text: Radiator was completely blocked. Rather than just replace it, he checked the whole system, identified a circulation problem, and sorted it. Professional, friendly, and the price was spot-on. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: David C.
